name: Mindblade Render
oracle_text: Whenever your opponents are dealt combat damage, if any of that damage was dealt by a Warrior, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
blocked_sentences: Whenever your opponents are dealt combat damage, if any of that damage was dealt by a Warrior, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.

needs.what: a once-per-combat-damage-step trigger keyed on the DAMAGED side: it fires once when one or more of your opponents are dealt combat damage in a step, by creatures of any controller (an opponent's Warrior hitting another opponent in a pod counts), and its filter (subtypes Warrior) must be satisfied by a creature that dealt combat damage to one of those opponents, not by a creature that hit you
needs.why_existing_wont_do: creatures_deal_combat_damage is fired once per DAMAGING seat with no `defender` on the batched form, so `defending: "opponent"` matches nothing unless `per_player` is set; `per_player` fires once per damaged opponent (draws two when Warriors hit two opponents, where the card triggers once per step); `controller: "you"` drops the opponents'-Warriors-hitting-other-opponents case; and no controller at all fires when an opponent's Warrior hits you. Each is a different card from the printed one
